hint.api: Pick a preset, then fill in the API Key.
hint.apiAdvanced: Configure API timeouts and invocation modes.
hint.tokens: View API call statistics and spending
hint.characterStyle: Manage desktop pet characters and reply styles; characters share memory
hint.appearance: Adjust window layout, UI theme and the Cyrene pet
hint.preferences: Set default preferences for the chat window and output
hint.channels: Connect Cyrene to messaging platforms like WeChat and Feishu. Each user on an external channel gets an independent chat context and memory.
hint.lsp: Configure language servers to provide smart completion, hover hints, go-to-definition and more for code editing.
hint.skills: Manage self-evolving skills: view, edit, delete, install external skills, backup and restore
hint.backup: Backup and restore persona, style and configuration
hint.general: Manage window, audio and system behavior
hint.cyrene: Control agent behaviors such as live status bar updates
